title: Inventory European Soil Evidence ROM reads
changes: Record an E231 selected-reader inventory of the existing Soil Evidence route and track the 3066 sampled bytes outside declared sources.
validation: Protected Wine unit tfe8gnqy compares 600 retained frames with matching state, clock, video, OAM, dispatch and five nonempty audio streams, and records 424583 distinct selected-reader requests over 241192 ROM bytes. Wine drained.
limitations: The address-only audit does not identify executing PCs, distinguish code from data or establish source extents, all readers or other scenes. Linux, USA and native Windows remain unverified; no performance comparison was made.
